name: Slitherblade Shore
summary: Slitherblade Shore stretches along the rugged northwestern coast of Desolace, running from the borders of Stonetalon Mountains down toward Sar'theris Strand. Dominated by hostile Slitherblade naga, the shoreline is littered with sunken shipwrecks and ancient sunken architecture that frames the promontory of Ethel Rethor.

sections.title: A Hostile Coastline
sections.body: Slitherblade Shore encompasses the windswept tidal sands of northern Desolace, bisected by the high promontory of Ethel Rethor. Off the surf lies Ranazjar Isle, where the serpent-like Slitherblade naga hold dominion under their sea priestesses. Shipwrecks churn in the shallow waters, washed ashore against ancient night elven stonework that sank during the Great Sundering and now slowly re-emerges from the tides.

faq.answer: The shoreline is heavily overrun by the Slitherblade naga, who patrol the shallows, tidal banks, and sunken ruins along the coast of Desolace.

faq.q: Where does Slitherblade Shore begin and end?
faq.answer: The shore extends from the northern cliffs bordering the Stonetalon Mountains down south toward Sar'theris Strand, centered around the ruined promontory of Ethel Rethor.

faq.q: What are all the ruined structures in the water?
faq.answer: The stone pillars and crumbled foundations scattered along the coast and near Ranazjar Isle are the remnants of ancient night elven cities that were swallowed by the Great Sundering ten thousand years ago.

faq.q: Why are there shipwrecks along the beach?
faq.answer: The treacherous reefs, unpredictable coastal tides, and aggressive naga presence make this stretch of sea a graveyard for vessels sailing along western Kalimdor.

angles.text: The naga infesting Slitherblade Shore are a bitter reminder of Queen Azshara's cursed legacy, defiling the drowned ruins of your ancient Highborne ancestors.
